title: PASSOVER COVENANT
EXODUS 12:13 PRAYER
end: The Covenant Shield — walk under God's daily covering
stock_queries: golden light rays through clouds morning threshold
sunlight streaming over tranquil valley and mountains
sunlit mountain pass golden peaceful sky
calm sunset over quiet stone refuge

scenes.a: If fear of sudden destruction threatens your peace in this room, hear God's promise now.
And the blood shall be to you for a token upon the houses where ye are: and when I see the blood,
I will pass over you, and the plague shall not be upon you to destroy you, when I smite the land of Egypt.
Lord, mark this household with Your divine protection today. Shield every doorway from harm and quiet every anxious thought.
May Your shadow cover this place so no destruction may enter. We rest secure under Your strong tower.
Subscribe to walk daily in His covenant protection.
